gateRecord.reason: A commit cannot contain its own hash. The archive commit is recorded in outputs\finish-integration-20261105\closeout\CLOSEOUT_RECEIPT.md after the commit lands.

fixes.change: journalShowsNoDispatch treats only ENOENT as a clean absence; EACCES/EPERM/EIO/ENOTDIR/unknown and a failed readdir all mean 'not proven'. A JournalFiles seam (6th constructor argument, default fs) makes both stages injectable.
regressions: gateway/test/desktop-queue.test.ts: an unreadable attempt journal never proves that a task was undelivered (7 injections: stat EACCES/EPERM/EIO/ENOTDIR/UNKNOWN, readdir EACCES/EIO)
gateway/test/desktop-queue.test.ts: only a genuinely absent journal directory still allows an undelivered closure (stat ENOENT)

fixes.change: process.kill(pid, 0) now counts as stopped only on ESRCH; EPERM means the process exists and stays alive.

runAutomationCli accepts an injectable runtime (client/resolveWorkspace/observeModel) so a recording client proves the composition root reaches TaskApplicationService.send. Defaults unchanged: still unarmed, still no HTTP/MCP write entry.
regressions: automation-cli-dispatch.test.ts: a legal decision is dispatched once, replayed for the same operationId, refused with OPERATION_CONFLICT for a different one, and never dispatched after policy-revoke

fixes.change: task.title and evidence.reviews[].correction are scrubbed like note/definition; a field holding the same secret twice is reported once.

delivery-export.test.ts: one field holding the same secret twice is reported once

fixes.change: Legacy prompt states plainly that prose never grants a write scope. Scope enforcement is unchanged; the B/C options (reject at admission, or derive scope from prose) are documented as user decisions.

assertBuildIsFresh runs from the release entry point: when src has a newer .ts than the oldest dist artifact by more than 2 s and both trees look real, packaging stops. A fixture-size floor keeps synthetic trees out of the rule.
regressions: package.test.ts: a stale dist is refused before anything is zipped
